focus_areas: Legibility and geometric correctness of dial numbers
Sharpness and realism of metallic casing reflections
Alignment of pointer hand with dial center
Edge definition between object and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact severity. AI often fails at rendering small, precise numbers on dials. If the image_text_auditor reports illegible or nonsensical numbers, this should significantly impact the alignment score despite the object looking like a barometer at a glance. Also, verify if the 'perspective_distortion' of the pointer is a real geometric error or just an optical effect of the angle.

The casing appears to be polished brass or gold-toned metal, mounted on a wooden surface or backing. The image is cropped tightly, showing only the right portion of the circular face and part of the mounting structure.

To rigorously audit the legibility and correctness of the numerical pressure markings, which are critical for this class.
